definitions.ja: 悪い；凶暴な；危険な；残酷な
definitions.km: អាក្រក់; គ្រោះថ្នាក់; ដាញ់; ឃោរឃៅ
definitions.th: ร้าย; ดุร้าย; อันตราย; ชั่วร้าย
definitions.vi: xấu; hung dữ; nguy hiểm; tàn ác

lao_examples.lao_script: ໝາຂອງເພື່ອນຂ້ອຍຮ້າຍຫຼາຍ ຢ່າໄປໃກ້
lao_examples.romanization: mǎː khɔ̌ːŋ pɨ̂an khɔ̂i hâːj lǎːj, yàː paj klâj
lao_examples.translation_en: My friend's dog is really fierce, don't go near it.

lao_examples.lao_script: ຄົນນັ້ນໃຈຮ້າຍງ່າຍ ລະວັງດ້ວຍ
lao_examples.romanization: khón nân tɕâj hâːj ŋàːj, lā wáŋ dûaj
lao_examples.translation_en: That person gets angry easily, be careful.
